findings.evidence: NEW FINDING — strict REVIEWER_PROTOCOL category 6 (4xx in network.json + DOM lacks [role=alert] / .toast / .alert-*). State 13 round-3 network.json contains exactly 3 entries, ALL 401: 2× GET http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/frontend/menu + 1× POST http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/frontend/kiosk-event. State 13 dom.html: kiosk-toast-container is `role='status' aria-live='polite' aria-relevant='additions text'` with ZERO child nodes (empty container). DOM grep for `role="alert"` returns 0 across the entire DOM, zero `.toast` class with content, zero `.alert-*` class. Visual PNG of state 13 ('QUEL MENU?' wizard step for Ailes de Poulet 6 pcs with 'SANS MENU' selected) shows clean wizard UI with no error banner, no toast, no warning chip — customer is given zero feedback that the menu reload + kiosk-event tracking POST failed. CRITICAL: git archaeology confirms this is a ROUND-3 REGRESSION — `git show 6f7e502b9:tests/e2e/__screenshots__/test-e2e-borne-C/13-313-j2-step-menu-flip-to-none.network.json` returns 0 total entries (round 2 state 13 had ZERO network calls during the capture window). Round 3 introduced 3× 401 in the same state. Round-3 wizard step rendered ('QUEL MENU?' kiosk-step-title) is IDENTICAL to round 2, so the traversal path is unchanged — the regression is in the auth/network behavior, not the spec. ROOT CAUSE: the silent re-login retry pattern documented in resources/js/app.js L99-130 (`__retry401Kiosk` flag → store.dispatch('kioskCart/kioskLogin') → axios.request retry) succeeds invisibly for the customer, but the FIRST 401 is recorded in the network log AND no toast is dispatched on the successful-retry path (onError of the helper is never invoked because the retry succeeded). The orchestrator's own commit message at efd9896a0 explicitly acknowledged this exact pattern: 'the retry succeeds, so onError is never invoked → P0 silent_error stays open'. They killed the symptom for /pricing/preview by removing the mount-time call, but did NOT generalize the fix to other endpoints that trigger the same retry path. Per strict protocol: this is a P0 silent_error.
findings.fix_hint: Two convergent options. Option A (recommended — generalized fix): in resources/js/app.js the 401 response interceptor (line 70-160) MUST dispatch a [role=alert] toast on ANY 401 capture even when the silent re-login retry succeeds — the customer's first call still failed and the protocol-category-6 evidence (4xx in network.json) is permanent. Suggested: after `__retry401Kiosk` is set and BEFORE the axios.request retry, fire `window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('kiosk-auth-retry', { detail: { url: cfg.url, status: 401 } }))` which KioskAppComponent already listens on (cf. existing `kiosk-auth-failed` listener pattern) and routes through KioskToastComponent. Toast copy: 'Connexion sécurisée renouvelée' (info severity, 3s, role=status acceptable for retry-success path) — OR upgrade to role=alert if reviewer protocol enforcement is strict. Option B (narrow fix — kill the root cause at source like C-001): identify why GET /api/frontend/menu and POST /api/frontend/kiosk-event fire at state 13 (menu-flip-to-none transition for item 313) without a fresh token — likely the j2 (second-item) reset flow in KioskWizardComponent.vue resets the kiosk:order Bearer prematurely. Investigate: (1) which composable calls /api/frontend/menu at the menu-flip-to-none transition (KioskAppComponent.vue refreshMenu listener?), (2) why the kiosk-event POST fires twice in the burst (kiosk-event sender is fire-and-forget per KioskAppComponent.vue:990 and KioskPaymentComponent.vue:697-816 — it should not error). Both options need verification + a 4th capture round.
